The goal is to ask the student a lot of interesting, student-centered questions.

Whichever type of English course you are interested in, whether it's for a child or teen, for general adult English, for Business English, or for a focus on pronunciation or interview preparation or any other special need, a trial lesson might be a good way to take a first step in sampling the world of online English learning.

pro_course_detail.title: English for Adults of All Levels, Beginners to Advanced
pro_course_detail.description:
From beginners to advanced students, I can help you work towards the next level in the development of your English language skills. Each course that I offer is adapted to your level and to your personal interests. 

I can help you reactivate your past knowledge of English, consolidate your current knowledge of English, and advance towards the next level. 

I can give you the opportunity to work on speaking practice, vocabulary, common expressions, general conversation, grammar, reading and listening skills, writing, pronunciation and other aspects of English, in the balance that you need and desire. 

We can work on all of the items on this list, or only on the things that you want to work on. I can also help you feel more comfortable and self-confident when speaking English and I can correct documents that you write in English.

pro_course_detail.title: Business English for People Who Want to Succeed
pro_course_detail.description:
You choose the focus of this course, which will be adapted to your level and to your special needs. The course can focus on the business English skills that you need in your current job or to obtain a better job, and can help you learn to use the proper degree of politeness and formality or informality for each situation that you find yourself in, so that you can maximize your interactions with everyone from colleagues to CEOs to prospective clients.

This course can help you master those specific business situations that you encounter in your particular job and fulfill your needs for English in your professional life. That may include work on such things as expressions and practice related to introducing yourself, discussing your job, business meetings, telephone calls, teleconferences, preparing for presentations, writing emails or letters or reports, negotiations, social situations, business dinners and business travel, as well as grammar, vocabulary, conversation and other aspects of general English, if desired. 

I’ve been a manager myself in a large institution and I have run my own business, so I have first hand experience using many business skills in the real world. Also, as a teacher, I’ve worked with doctors and lawyers and top managers from many French and international companies, such as KPMG, HSBC, PricewaterhouseCoopers, France Telecom, Louis Vuitton, Lindt Chocolates and Dior.

SUMMARY :

This course can focus on any business needs or other special professional needs that you have, in the short-term or in the long-term, and help you prepare to meet the challenges of work and a successful career that includes the use of English.

pro_course_detail.title: English for Children or Teens, Ages 7-15
pro_course_detail.description:
I’ve been working with children for more than 40 years and I know how to put them at ease and how to reach them.

If children enjoy English they will make faster progress and can develop a lifelong positive association with language learning. 

Using a creative approach and lots of visual elements, plus songs and games, and some materials that I have developed myself, I can help your primary school children get ahead by starting English at a young age and developing a positive attitude towards English. I can get them speaking and help them master pronunciation basics before they have a chance to develop bad habits from listening only to nonnative speakers at school.

I can help your middle school students succeed at school, plus gain a deeper understanding of how the English language works than they can get at school. They can advance beyond the classroom and gain the self-confidence to speak and read and write in English. 

I can teach all kids basic skills, such as how to have a first conversation or learn the vocabulary of the world around them. Depending on the children’s ages, they can also see basic grammar and the logic of how English is constructed, and start to build their speaking, reading, listening, writing and pronunciation skills. 

I can help them understand the English that they are learning at school, too, and do a better job with their school homework and exams, and feel more self-confident when speaking.

My years of experience as an English teacher, children’s librarian and professional storyteller can be put to your service to help your children maximize their potentials as English language learners.

pro_course_detail.title: English for High School and University Students, Ages 16 and Older
pro_course_detail.description:
I’ve been working with teens and young adults for many years so I know how to put them at ease, help them do their best and provide them with a safe environment in which they can express their ideas and gain the self-confidence necessary to speak fluently in English.

Adapting each course to the student’s level and needs, I can help high school and university students do better in their school English classes or prepare for exchange programs in English-speaking countries, with the revision of basic grammar and exposure to more advanced grammar, vocabulary, reading, listening, writing, conversation and pronunciation skills. 

I can help them understand the logic of how English is constructed so that they can move beyond conjugation formulas and use correct English more independently.

In addition, I can help students prepare for national exams, Cambridge exams, and more. 

SUMMARY :

To sum up, I can make students feel more comfortable when speaking English and help them communicate more naturally in English. I can also help them understand the English that they are learning at school in more depth, so that they can do a better job on their school assignments and more effectively prepare for exams.

pro_course_detail.title: CV and Interview Preparation, Exam Preparation or Other Special Needs for English
pro_course_detail.description:
CV OR INTERVIEW PREPARATION :
If you need a CV or to prepare for a school entrance interview or job interview in English, I can help you maximize your chances for success. I’ve written many CVs and had many job interviews and, as a manager, I have interviewed job applicants, so I know what’s needed to perform well. I can help you anticipate possible interview questions and prepare well thought out responses to them. I can offer guidelines on which verb tenses are required to answer specific questions about general skills and experience, about past positions, about current jobs and about future career plans. Advance preparation also builds your self-confidence and prevents hesitation over how to answer questions or how to express responses in English. I’ve helped many people get the jobs that they’d hoped to get. I can help you, too.

EXAM PREPARATION :
Prepare for special exams by focusing on grammar, reading, writing and listening skills, correcting practice exams, and speaking to gain the fluency and self-confidence you need for an important exam. Feeling prepared can help reduce your stress so that you can do your best on exams testing your English level or exams written in English that test your knowledge of other subjects.

OTHER SPECIAL NEEDS :
Do you have some other special need for English ? I can design an entire course to help you read articles on medical subjects, read fairy tales from around the world, write poetry or prepare for a vacation in an English-speaking country. I can edit documents you have written in English, correcting grammar and producing more natural sounding English. Whatever you need, I can plan a special course just for you.

SUMMARY :
This course is designed for your specific needs and goals, whether they involve obtaining your dream job, working in another country, succeeding on an important exam, entering an English-speaking university, making the most of travel, or pursuing some special secret desire related to English literature.

pro_course_detail.title: Pronunciation for Professionals
pro_course_detail.description:
Is pronunciation holding you back from getting a job in another country or advancing your career at home ?

Do you need to speak in English at work, at home or when traveling ?

Have you ever had trouble understanding what English speakers are saying to you ?

Have you ever experienced the frustration of speaking pretty well in English, and yet still not being understood ?

I can help you with these problems.

I've been teaching English since 1998 and have helped students from around the world learn to pronounce English more clearly and correctly. I can explain and help you practice basic English vowel and consonant sounds, silent letters, and inconsistencies in English pronunciation rules. Together we can work on the specific sounds in English that are a problem for people who speak your native language and the distinctions between similar sounding words. I can teach you proper word stress, intonation and sentence stress, and help you with homophones and homonyms, and more.

course_info.trial_description:
PLEASE NOTE: The trial lesson is for getting to know each other, making a study plan, and general conversation. It is NOT for practicing interviews, editing papers, or other one-time services. Thanks for respecting my policy!

How are you learning English?  How can you improve your practice time? Let's make a plan and get to know each other!

In this trial lesson, I'll ask you to introduce yourself and talk about your English learning goals. Next, we'll discuss a study plan as well as practice and study tips. This is your chance to ask me any questions about language learning, my background, and my approach. Finally, we'll have a short, topic-based conversation akin to my "Conversation" classes, including a study sheet.

Let's get cracking!

pro_course_detail.title: Conversation (adults)
pro_course_detail.description:
Let's have a conversation! In this lesson, you'll have a 30- or 60-minute conversation in English with plenty of talk time.

Topics are arranged in four 10-lesson packages, each with practice sheets that include topic-specific vocabulary, phrasal verbs, collocations, expressions, idioms, and slang. I've been writing, editing, and improving these sheets for you for more than half a decade of teaching, across thousands of lessons. Topics align with IELTS and TOEFL speaking standards. Notes, suggestions, and practice points provided in real time during each lesson.

Looking for something more organic? Let's just talk. You can pick a topic or an article to discuss, or we can just shoot the breeze! Don't stress out – I've got plenty of questions to keep you talking! I'm used to be a journalist, so I'm a great listener and can keep the conversation moving.

Got questions? Send me a message!

For both preschool and primary school aged children, I will typically use pictures to help promote and practice speaking and listening skills.

- Enseñaba inglés en América del Sur; Certificado TESOL; mucha experiencia con estudiantes latinoamericanos; Mi pasión es en ayudar a los estudiantes motivados  alcanzar sus metas.
2009年，我住在台灣台北，在那裡學習了一個學期。
I began teaching in Taiwan in 2009, doing conversation groups at Shih Hsin University. This challenged me immediately, and I still look back on it as a period of growth. A few years later I had the honor and privilege to teach a semester in Korea at a kindergarten, dancing and singing the days away with some fun little ones! 

Then in 2014, the big challenge: starting a new program in Longaví, Chile, from scratch...I was the first ever native English speaker at two rural schools! Los Cristales and La Quinta will forever be in my heart, for their warm welcome and eagerness to get down to business and educate the kids, despite all the challenges of living in a remote location. 3 years later, both of these schools have thriving ESL programs in an area of South America where native speakers are few and far between. This was a great privilege. After that came an elective at a public high school on travel English, a continued position at a private school in Linares where I live, and a lot of fun teaching adults from all professional backgrounds. The most important thing for me is to remain positive and upbeat as a teacher, and always challenge the students. Lecture is boring...I want the student involved. 

Adults love to talk and forcing them to talk in their 2nd language is the ONLY way to gain verbal fluency. Vocabulary lessons are indeed important, and that vocabulary needs to be put into context....through topical conversation. I can´t wait to help out students on italki, as I´ve been able to help hundreds of Chilean, Korean and Taiwanese students before them. This is my passion.

pro_course_detail.title: The English Cafe |☕| Conversation, Grammar, Natural Expression, Functional and Useful Language Practice
pro_course_detail.description:
Benvenuti to The English Cafe! Here we'll craft your ideal English learning experience. Here's a taste of what's available:

1. Do you want to have spontaneous chats to practice your conversational English? Great! We can chat about life, a topic of your choice, etc, and find new vocabulary and more natural ways to express your thoughts. 
2. Do you prefer more structure to a lesson? I have a few options for you! 1] Speaking Lessons on various topics. These classes will be 45 or 60 minutes long and are based on a topic that I will send to you and let you choose before the lesson. This requires no preparation on your part, just show up and engage! 2] Reading and discussing an article. These will be 30 or 45-minute lessons. You will read an article before the lesson, then we will discuss it during the lesson and work on any difficult vocabulary. You will have the option to choose from a list of topics that I will send you. 3] If you struggle with any particular grammar, functional language, or vocabulary, we can do a 30, 45, or 60-minute lesson based on your needs.
3. Do you have material you want to bring to the table and get practice with? Great! Let me know what you have prepared so we can discuss and refine it.

Important: This is for strong A2/B1-C2 as you need to be comfortable chatting and holding conversations in English. All lessons are hosted entirely in English.
